Tests that Network events for navigation preload requests are reported on the service worker target.

-----------------
Loading an iframe.
requestWillBeSent:
  url: http://127.0.0.1:8000/inspector-protocol/service-worker/resources/navigation-preload-scope.php
  request.headers['Service-Worker-Navigation-Preload']: hello
responseReceived:
  status: 200
  timing available: true
loadingFinished
The iframe loaded.
-----------------
Loading another iframe.
requestWillBeSent:
  url: http://127.0.0.1:8000/inspector-protocol/service-worker/resources/navigation-preload-scope.php?BrokenChunked
  request.headers['Service-Worker-Navigation-Preload']: hello
responseReceived:
  status: 200
  timing available: true
loadingFailed:
  errorText: net::ERR_INVALID_CHUNKED_ENCODING
The iframe loaded.
-----------------
Loading another iframe.
requestWillBeSent:
  url: http://127.0.0.1:8000/inspector-protocol/service-worker/resources/navigation-preload-scope.php?Redirect
  request.headers['Service-Worker-Navigation-Preload']: hello
responseReceived:
  status: 302
  timing available: true
loadingFinished
The iframe loaded.
-----------------
Done
